name: Chaman Lal Setia Exports Ltd.
summary: Chaman Lal Setia Exports Ltd. cultivates, processes and sells rice, including basmati and non-basmati varieties and value-added rice products. Its premium Maharani label includes Basmati Rice 1121, Royal Basmati and Supreme Basmati, while other basmati brands include Mithas, Begum and Nezzah. Mr. Chaman Lal Setia founded it in 1974, and its main office is in New Delhi.
